review: Read personal device/Codex registration and its complete suite, plus the local developer USB component and its complete suite. AccountSessionPanel and InstalledServicesPanel parent changes remain separate review work.

Personal computer approval, personal Codex setup and finite task pairing remain separate authorities. Actions are explicit; native bridge status supplies bounded messages and completion receipts. No credential or approval is created by rendering.

Reproduced nine lifecycle regressions: late success/error for four setup actions across account-session replacement, and late browser-open completion after unmount starting a poll. Existing completion generations now guard action results, errors, final busy state and invalidation events. Session inspection resets busy state. No issued native operation is cancelled by this UI guard.

Private USB controls distinguish issuer ownership from ordinary account access. Issuer bootstrap is shown only with explicit canBootstrapIssuer; an existing issuer owner can renew. Import remains explicit; native enforcement and review remain authoritative. USB grants do not authorize model usage, game actions, room sources or task pairing.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal; no publication or native action performed.
Thirty mocked tests exercise UI only. Native account binding, credential custody, approval enforcement, installed behavior and final public release remain separate acceptance.
The new guards suppress stale action continuations. Native completion events rely on native owner attribution; this cohort does not qualify the complete cross-account backend/IPC lifecycle.
AccountSessionPanel, InstalledServicesPanel, AgentAccessPanel and their other dependencies remain under review. This is not a full application build.
Five intentional support-contact matches inherited from the previous candidate remain in the final owner publication review.
